import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Fill empty Sleep Disorder values
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars1 = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='%.1f')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='coolwarm', 
                      s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity Level')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_bmi,
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 4. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors_disorder = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
bars4 = ax4.bar(disorder_counts.index, disorder_counts.values, color=colors_disorder)
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')
ax4.bar_label(bars4)

# 5. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
scatter2 = ax5.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                       c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                       s=150, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax5)
cbar2.set_label('Quality of Sleep')

# 6. Physical Activity vs Sleep Duration by BMI
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax6.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Sleep Duration'], 
                label=bmi, s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax6.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax6.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Duration')
ax6.legend(title='BMI Category')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
